_comment: The coach's own record of current 1RMs; calc.py reads it. Source to check when a lift is missing or stale: the athlete's 'CF Goal Tracker' Google Sheet (xrm_sheet_id) — the '1RMs' tab is the summary, the '2026-2027' tab holds this season's XRMs (older: '2024-25'). Confirm with the athlete before changing a value. POLP lifts don't use this file; their loads come from the POLP workbook.
